ns2:section.sectionText: In this seminar, we will examine how practices of music-making, listening, and fandom participate in the construction of gender and sexual identities, the ways gender and sexuality are encoded in sound and musical gesture, and relationships between music, bodies, and desire. Literature will concern musics and identity formations from a range of cultural perspectives. We will also read relevant feminist and queer scholarship from outside the music disciplines. (This course is affiliated with the Unit for Criticism and Interpretive Theory.)
